title: Galactic Language
body:
Galactic Language

> *Translate all of Minecraft into the Standard Galactic Alphabet*

## 📖 What is this?

You know those symbols on the enchanting table? This pack replaces every single line of text in the game with exactly that - the Standard Galactic Alphabet. Menus, tooltips, item names, advancements, death messages, all of it. All **7 886 translation keys**.

Galactic shows up as a proper language in Options → Language under *Galactic (Galaxy)*, not some hacky overlay.

## ✨ Features

- 🔤 Full translation — 7 886 strings, nothing left in English
- 🌌 Appears as a real selectable language in the language menu
- ⚡ Tiny file size (~150 KB), no performance hit
- 🔧 Works on all modern versions

## 🎮 How to install

1. Download the `.zip`
2. Drop it into `.minecraft/resourcepacks/` (don't unzip it)
3. Go to **Options → Resource Packs** and enable *GalacticLanguage*
4. Then **Options → Language** → pick **Galactic (Galaxy)**
5. ᒷリ⋮𝙹||!

## 🔢 Compatibility

| Minecraft | Status |
|-----------|--------|
| 26.x | ✅ Tested |
| 1.21.x | ✅ Works |
| 1.20.x | ✅ Works |
| 1.16+ | ✅ Works |

Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, vanilla — all good.

## ❓ FAQ

**Language not showing up?**
The pack needs to be enabled in Resource Packs first, then go to Language. Order matters.

**Some text is still English?**
Mods add their own translation keys which this pack doesn't cover. Vanilla only.
